name: Travel & Tourism
title: Travel and Tourism
intro: The tourism roadmap: BA or BBA admission, tourism and aviation modules, internships, certifications and careers.

phases.title: Class 11–12: build awareness
phases.summary: Any stream; communication and geography awareness help.
points: Travel and tourism programmes accept students from any stream.
Build communication skills in English and, if possible, a foreign language.
Learn about Indian and world geography, culture and heritage.
Practise teamwork and customer-service attitude.

phases.title: Admission process
phases.summary: CUET-UG or merit at universities and institutes.
points: Apply for BA Tourism, BBA Tourism and Travel Management or similar through university portals.
Specialised institutes such as IITTM run programmes with their own selection routes.
Check recognition and placement support.
Confirm admission by paying fees.

phases.title: Course structure
phases.summary: Tourism products, travel operations and management.
points: Year 1: Tourism Principles, Geography of Tourism, Communication Skills and Business Basics.
Year 2: Travel Agency and Tour Operations, Ticketing, Hospitality, Tourism Marketing and Culture.
Year 3: Aviation and Airport Management, Event Management, Sustainable Tourism and a project.
Study tours and field visits are common.

phases.title: Certifications and internships
phases.summary: Learn the industry tools and gain experience.
points: Take IATA travel and tourism certificates and learn GDS systems such as Amadeus or Galileo.
Intern with travel agencies, airlines, hotels and tourism boards.
Learn itinerary building, costing and customer handling.
Consider a government-approved tourist guide certificate through the Ministry of Tourism (IITTM).

phases.title: Careers and higher study
phases.summary: Travel, airlines, hospitality, events and entrepreneurship.
points: Roles: travel consultant, tour manager, airline ground staff, cabin crew (with separate selection), event coordinator and destination manager.
Government and PSU roles: state tourism boards and IRCTC.
Higher study: MBA in Tourism, MTTM or hospitality management.
Entrepreneurship: tour operations, homestays and experiential travel.
